cc:Work.dc:title: stokes-brinkman convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: stokes-brinkman; all 5 measured levels; fixed final-four diagnostic window. Stabilized P3/P3 USFEM locals; vector P1 traces; viscosity one, zero drag. Smooth polynomial crisscross-mesh family; nu=1, drag=0, P1 vector trace; one local triangle; H=1/n is the actual triangle diameter. Analytical physical field errors. Record examples/results/stokes-adaptive/polynomial-uniform-nu1-g0-l1.json; SHA256 a2248fb906e8957977d57a746645b154acd63153edb0cc40ca7be46f354e8c68. Araya, Harder, Poza and Valentin (2017): smooth velocity/pressure estimates. CC BY 4.0 — IPES Research Group; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
